name: DVC
tagline: Git extension for versioning data, models, and ML experiments.
description: DVC (Data Version Control) brings software-engineering practices to machine learning: it versions datasets, models, and pipelines alongside code in any Git repository, storing large files in your own remote storage while keeping lightweight pointers in Git. Enables reproducible experiments, data/model lineage, and pipeline orchestration from the command line.
insight: Originally built by Iterative; the DVC project is now part of lakeFS, which acquired it and maintains it alongside its data-lake platform.

modelSupport.notes: Versioning and pipeline tooling — no LLM involved.

edge: A lightweight Git extension that versions datasets and ML models next to code with no server to run — unlike data-lake platforms such as lakeFS.
pros: Versions data and models with Git
cons: Large-scale lakes better served by lakeFS
